papers.title: Revisit to Segment: Working Memory Distillation for Reasoning Segmentation
papers.reason: This paper uses working memory to describe an image-segmentation model's internal context and distillation process rather than human or animal cognition.

papers.title: MAC-Net: A Multi-Task Deep Learning Framework for Modeling Cognitive Function From Task-Based fMRI
papers.reason: The paper predicts individual cognitive function from task-based fMRI and identifies frontal, parietal, and cingulate features associated with N-back working-memory performance.

papers.title: Recovery-Directed Symbolic Distillation of Neural Likelihoods
papers.reason: The method improves interpretable and efficient parameter recovery for the diffusion decision model, a process model of human decision making, and demonstrates hierarchical inference on empirical data.

papers.title: Subregion-specific temporal lobe EEG signatures in amnestic mild cognitive impairment: Evidence from high-density EEG.
papers.reason: High-density EEG signatures in amnestic mild cognitive impairment are relevant to early-detection biomarkers, although the available title emphasizes temporal-lobe memory pathology rather than executive function.

papers.title: Everyday Discrimination Alters Cognitive Benefits of Restorative NREM Sleep in Black Adults
papers.reason: The study relates sleep physiology and discrimination to global cognition and visuospatial memory but does not specifically investigate executive function or its computational assessment.

papers.title: Cortical Ribboning and Periodic EEG Discharges in Probable Sporadic CreutzfeldtJakob Disease
papers.reason: This single-case diagnostic report combines MRI and EEG for rapidly progressive cognitive decline but provides no specific findings or modelling of executive function.
